prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pilot-04
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): c7f5c46bbf78b61a
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback sent 0xa5 but reg_dat_do returned 0x25 (0xa5 & 0x7F, MSB cleared). recv_buf_data is declared as reg [7:1] on line 42, a 7-bit vector, so an 8-bit receive pattern loses bit[7] on assignment and zero-extends on read via line 53. Widening to [7:0] preserves the full byte.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash c7f5c46bbf78b61a in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
